description: This file defines a Polymer element for a 'Todos' application interface, including templates, styles, and embedded JavaScript for behavior. It imports various Polymer and web component dependencies and manages UI interactions for a todo list.

methods.name: _computeLinkClass
methods.description: Computes CSS class for filter links based on current route.

methods.name: _computeAnyCompleted
methods.description: Determines if any items are completed.

methods.name: _computeActiveCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of active (incomplete) items.

methods.name: _computeAllCompleted
methods.description: Determines if all items are completed.

methods.name: _computeItemsLeft
methods.description: Returns singular or plural 'item(s)' based on count.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Returns a function to filter items based on current route.

methods.name: addTodoAction
methods.description: Handles adding a new todo item from input field.

methods.name: cancelAddTodoAction
methods.description: Handles canceling the add operation and clearing input.

methods.name: destroyItemAction
methods.description: Handles removal of a Todo item.

methods.name: toggleAllCompletedAction
methods.description: Marks all items as completed or not based on toggle.
